## About
Atlantic Coast Collision is a family owned and operated collision and repair center in Margate, Florida. Our employees are I-car and ASE certified, and we treat each vehicle as if it was the only one in our shop.
Whether you have a few scratches or your car has been in a serious accident, our team works hard to make it come out looking like nothing ever happened. We also handle paint, glass, mechanical repairs, maintenance and detailing.
We aim to give you clear estimates and make your visit a pleasant one from start to finish. Customers on Google rate us 4.7 from 571 reviews.

## Services
- Car accident repairs: Accident repairs on all makes and models, from minor damage to serious collisions.
- Body work and paint: Full body and interior work, paint and more, so your car looks like nothing ever happened.
- Window and windshield: Crack repair or a new window or windshield.
- Oil change and maintenance: A dealer alternative for routine work like oil changes, spark plugs and maintenance.
- Detailing: Detailing, including high end detailing.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: We are qualified to work with any insurance company in the State of Florida.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: Our Margate shop is easy to reach from anywhere in Broward and South Palm Beach County.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM.

Q: How do I schedule an appointment?
A: Give us a call at 954-969-7661.
